plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETF risk.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and build cash.

conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for lower, steadier gains around 1.5% per month. The focus is on reducing overall risk and building a cash cushion, which will limit upside potential but also significantly reduce potential drawdowns.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to manage leveraged ETF risk.
Trim SPY to 25% to meet the concentration mandate.
Reduce CRWD to 15% to diversify holdings.

balanced.read: This balanced strategy targets approximately 2.5% monthly growth by blending index exposure with quality tech. It reduces concentration and leverage to acceptable levels, aiming for risk-first growth with moderate drawdowns.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the concentration mandate.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for high growth, targeting around 4% per month, by increasing leverage and concentrating in top-rated setups. Be aware that this significantly raises potential drawdowns and is subject to leveraged ETF decay; strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to remove leveraged ETF risk.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and increase cash.
Reduce CRWD to 5% to minimize exposure to high-beta tech.
Increase QQQI to 30% to maximize income generation.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% monthly distributions by prioritizing income-generating assets like QQQI. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leverage and high-beta names, aiming for low drawdowns and reliable income, though NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
